items.q: there was a great sax player named Haywood Henry, [inaudible] for Erskine Hawkins.

ctx.x: He came here and played, and I’m thinking he just comes up with this little riff and I’m thinking to myself I could never have thought of that. It’s so perfect.
It’s funny that I’m going to skip forward, for many years there was a great sax player named Haywood Henry, [inaudible] for Erskine Hawkins.
